{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true prices - model underforecasts by ~1-2 dollars daily",
    "Lag effect: model predictions trail behind true price movements, failing to capture rapid reversals",
    "Sentiment alignment: high sentiment (1.0) correlates with above-forecast price levels, low sentiment (0.0) correlates with below-forecast levels",
    "Mean-reversion bias: model continues extrapolating recent trends too far, while true prices revert to trading ranges",
    "Price level bias: model underestimates peak levels in uptrends and underestimates recovery in downtrends",
    "Sentiment amplification: the gap between forecast and truth expands when sentiment is extreme (0.67 or 1.0) compared to neutral (0.33-0.50)",
    "Delay in sentiment incorporation: model forecasts show less sentiment variation than the true price history, creating systematic under- or over-valuation"
] }
